name: Saheeli Rai
description: Saheeli Rai is a master inventor and metalsmith from Kaladesh who was a planeswalker, with magical command over metal, and is Huatli's partner.

description_citations.text: "Saheeli". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Saheeli Rai is a master inventor and metalsmith from Kaladesh who was a planeswalker, with magical command over metal, and is Huatli's partner.

citations.text: "Saheeli". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: On Kaladesh she first refused to help Rashmi with a dangerous matter transporter, then supplied a new filament and reconciled with her as a friend.

citations.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.
"A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.
"A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

bio.text: She later rescued Rashmi, and she and Rashmi designed the disruptor thopter Hope of Ghirapur, with which she helped defend the airship by turning attacking thopters to lead.

citations.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.
"Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

bio.text: She met Huatli on Kaladesh and they became friends, and years later they discovered they were pen pals attracted to each other and left on a date.

citations.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

bio.text: On Dominaria she built a replica of the sylex and the Temporal Anchor time machine, and was earlier forced by Gonti to repair his failing aether heart.

citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

bio.text: When Phyrexia invaded, she warned Pia, launched Operation Golden Scales to defend Ghirapur, and explained that without Norn the compleated are inert and asleep.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

bio.text: Afterward she found she could no longer planeswalk, and was stranded on Ixalan.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

bio.text: There she became a subject of the Sun Empire building filigree quetzacama for the emperor, and transcribed a secret meeting at Sen Gael whose contract the three leaders signed.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

status.text: She is alive and a former planeswalker on Ixalan, who asked Quint's help with a discovery there.

citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli finds Rashmi at the inquirium and learns the filament broke.
timeline.quote: The bright young inventor was standing in the middle of the workshop

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli offers to speak to Padeem about the aether condenser.
timeline.quote: I know Padeem well enough.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi tells Saheeli about the working matter transporter.
timeline.quote: Mitul and I designed a matter transporter, and it works!

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli refuses to help, saying the device is too dangerous.
timeline.quote: It's too dangerous.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi accuses Saheeli of jealousy as she leaves.
timeline.quote: Are you jealous?

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli spends the night in automaton duels with the renegades at the arena.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had been automaton dueling with the renegades all through the night.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reasons she has a responsibility as a planeswalker who knows about the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: She had a responsibility being a Planeswalker, knowing what she knew about the Blind Eternities.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli wins her twenty-fifth duel of the night.
timeline.quote: Which puts her at a perfect twenty-five for the night!

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Signing a young fan's autograph book, Saheeli reads her own quote about innovation without bounds and is shaken.
timeline.quote: Well, isn't that something to have shoved in your face?

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli returns to the inquirium and Mitul slams the door in her face.
timeline.quote: Mitul slammed the door in her face.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli offers a new filament and says Padeem will give Rashmi an audience if it works.
timeline.quote: Padeem promised me she would give you an audience if it works.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: The transporter successfully moves the vase across the room, and Saheeli hopes she did the right thing.
timeline.quote: The ring floated up from the table, and as it did, the vase flickered away.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals she bought Padeem's audience with a front-row duel seat.
timeline.quote: A front-row seat at the underground artificer duel next month.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi learns that Padeem was once an underground quicksmith.
timeline.quote: The best of her time,

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli apologizes and she and Rashmi reconcile.
timeline.quote: Rashmi drew Saheeli into an embrace.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli tells Chandra and Pia that the inventions of the Fair and Rashmi are gone.
timeline.quote: I think they took Rashmi and the others

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reassembles scrap into replica automatons and uses a golden automaton to destroy the Consulate automaton.
timeline.quote: Saheeli pumped a fist in triumph.

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals she has found where Tezzeret is hiding, in a private workshop in the central Aether Spire, where he holds the winning inventor.
timeline.quote: He has locked himself away in a private workshop, hidden in the central Aether Spire.

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana volunteers to infiltrate with Saheeli; Gideon reluctantly agrees and tells her to do what is right.
timeline.quote: "Fine. Liliana will go."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli rescues Rashmi in her construct and tells her Mitul is safe.
timeline.quote: "He's safe," Saheeli said.

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi realizes Saheeli knew the transporter's implications and senses the planeswalker nature in her; Saheeli welcomes her to the renegade movement.
timeline.quote: "Welcome to the renegade movement, my friend. I have much to tell you."

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia, Saheeli and Rashmi reveal Hope of Ghirapur, a modified thopter carrying an aetheric disruptor to cripple the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: "Rashmi and Saheeli have designed a specially modified thopter," said Pia.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Saheeli defend the airship against thopter swarms; Saheeli turns attackers to lead.
timeline.quote: Saheeli reached out with a spell, magically transmuting their delicate metals to clumsy lead.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Saheeli talk about Chandra's father and whether Saheeli would leave Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: "I'm sorry about your father," Saheeli said, unbidden.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Saheeli discovers the hollowed-out thopter; the group debates calling off the attack.
timeline.quote: "We need to call it off," he said.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra proposes to be the disruptor herself by riding the thopter into the Bridge; Gideon objects but she insists.
timeline.quote: "From close range, I could be the disruptor.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Saheeli, a fellow planeswalker, pulls Huatli aside and introduces herself.
timeline.quote: My name is Saheeli.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Saheeli names the plane Kaladesh and the city Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: This plane is Kaladesh, and this city is Ghirapur.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Saheeli takes Huatli to her workshop to make a dinosaur.
timeline.quote: We are going back to my workshop right now so you can describe them to me.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Gruul, Simic and Izzet storm a hill together, and Huatli, Saheeli Rai and Kasmina join; Bombop and a Simic shaman are killed.
timeline.quote: Poor Bombop rushed in too far ahead of the rest of us.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: R replies that she is no spy but a lady, and that the copper is for a project for a friend; she asks what brings Huatli to the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm a lady, not a liar.

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: R answers that her mentor's inability to be impressed has made her a creator who never stops, and says she thinks Huatli's wish is beautiful.
timeline.quote: My mentor's inability to be impressed has led me to be the kind of creator who can't ever put down my tools and call it a day.

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: R invites Huatli to meet on Dominaria; Huatli agrees, and R later proposes a drink.
timeline.quote: Want to meet up for a drink?

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Huatli proposes meeting at Iveta's Tavern at moonrise, and R accepts and suggests dancing afterward in New Capenna.
timeline.quote: We can meet at Iveta's for round one and planeswalk from there?

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: On her way to the tavern, Huatli runs into Saheeli, whom she met on Kaladesh on her first planeswalk, and rushes off without confessing her feelings.
timeline.quote: "I have to go," Huatli adds, interrupting whatever Saheeli was about to say.

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: At Iveta's Tavern, Huatli and Saheeli discover that H is Huatli and R is Rai, each the stranger the other has been writing to.
timeline.quote: "R is for Rai."

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: The two women share coffee, leave together, and kiss under Ravnica's sky before planeswalking to another plane.
timeline.quote: their lips gently and tentatively meet under the indigo reach of Ravnica's sky

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli leads Teferi to her device in Urza's tower, where he resolves to cross time to learn how to activate the sylex.
timeline.quote: Teferi would do the one thing he had vowed never to do: cross time itself.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah gives Teferi Kjeldoran biscuits made by Saheeli's construct, and Teferi asks him to lead while he is away on the time machine.
timeline.quote: I'd like you to consider being that person.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli shows Teferi her perfect replica of the sylex and the nearly ready Temporal Anchor.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had crafted a perfect replica of the sylex

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli gives Teferi a clockwork peafowl and says the Anchor will be ready that night.
timeline.quote: The Anchor will be ready to use tonight.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaya extends her ghostform over the coffin while Saheeli powers up the Temporal Anchor in a test, but the circuitry fails in a shower of sparks.
timeline.quote: A shower of sparks poured out from a bank of circuitry

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli finds the wiring torn apart, and Kaya shields her from an explosion, with both sensing a melancholy presence hovering nearby.
timeline.quote: extending her ghostform to protect them both from the explosion

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaya identifies a black crystal orb from Teferi as the cause and wants to know why it creates ghosts.
timeline.quote: a black crystal orb encased in a cage of silver

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Saheeli wakes tied to a chair in a room of stolen art as Gonti, who knows everything about her family, addresses her.
timeline.quote: she woke up tied to a chair in this place.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gonti reveals their cracked-stone chest and failing aether heart and demands Saheeli repair it.
timeline.quote: It has begun to fail.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gonti threatens to have Saheeli's family executed, starting with her mother, and shows her mother's bracelet.
timeline.quote: If I don't send word in the allotted time, their instructions are to execute everyone.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Kaya find Jodah speaking with Jhoira, who asks if Teferi is still bent on going back in time.
timeline.quote: He's still bent on going back?

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah recognizes Urza's work in the orb and reveals Urza was the tower's builder, Teferi's teacher and his ancestor.
timeline.quote: Teferi's teacher. And my ancestor.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah reveals Thran script in the orb's cage reading, Go back to the beginning and greet me properly.
timeline.quote: It's the written language of the Thran, an ancient civilization on this plane,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Saheeli repairs Gonti's cracked silver filament, learning Gonti is immortal, and Gonti reveals the threat was a test of faith.
timeline.quote: A small fracture in the filament had developed over time

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Kaya spring a trap that gives the spirit a semblance of solidity using the rhythm of Gonti's heart.
timeline.quote: Saheeli's trap worked!

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The spirit shoves Saheeli aside, hacks the anchor with a ghostly blade and flees; Kaya pursues.
timeline.quote: The blade struck the anchor, gouging a deep gash into its side.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Jodah find Kaya facing the spirit, who gives his name as Sharaman, the leader of Urza's armies.
timeline.quote: General Sharaman,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli begins the final run with Teferi in the coffin and Kaya in position.
timeline.quote: Saheeli switched on the anchor.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: At a watchtower, Elspeth sets up one of Saheeli's cylinder turrets and tries to pray, remembering that Ajani is compleated.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled a steel-clad cylinder from her sack

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian attack begins at night; Elspeth finds Saheeli and Kaya straining to keep the Anchor running for Teferi.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian attack came in the dead of night.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra discuss the situation with Kaya and Saheeli: Jace's alliance is gathering and the Mirrans are about to attack.
timeline.quote: Jace has it on good authority that the Mirrans are going to launch their offensive very soon,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Chandra says no cost is too high to destroy the Phyrexians, clashing with Nissa and Saheeli.
timeline.quote: My point is that destroying the Phyrexians is the most important thing. No cost is too high.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR, Teferi lies in a metal coffin and signals Kaya that he is ready to send his spirit back in time after a month of testing.
timeline.quote: Teferi knocked twice on the inside of the lid. He was ready.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Kaya and Saheeli plan how to find the true sylex's activation, and Teferi picks The Antiquities War as the key text, aiming for the Last Battle on Argoth.
timeline.quote: We go here—the last battle of the Brothers' War.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi explains Saheeli's insight: send only a spirit back, since silver travel would be like dousing oneself in lamp oil.
timeline.quote: By extracting one's spirit and casting that back, one would be unable to interact with the past while remaining able to observe

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Back in the present, Teferi tells Kaya and Saheeli he has found blotted time, while the anchor may not survive another trip.
timeline.quote: I saw it, like a scar. Part of the tapestry blotted out, like ink spilled on a page.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns sick and tells the others he almost has it, then goes back for one last attempt as Kaya warns it is brutal.
timeline.quote: Last one,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Pia recalls Saheeli's warning of an invasion and the Phyrexian eye symbol appearing everywhere.
timeline.quote: We have to be ready for an invasion,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Pia and Saheeli address the consulate and prepare Ghirapur, evacuating citizens and arming skyships.
timeline.quote: If Pia allocated the resources to fight, then fight they would.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli's Operation Golden Scales deploys bronze lizards that clash with Phyrexian soldiers, and she rescues Pia.
timeline.quote: Deployment chambers spring up from hatches all along the street

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Pia race to the reservoir, noting the Phyrexians are heading there and that converted guards cannot yet be saved.
timeline.quote: We can't do anything to save them,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli evades telling Pia what happened to Chandra.
timeline.quote: Pia's been around politicians long enough to know when she isn't getting the whole story.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Baji offers his skimmer and Pia boards it, but a Phyrexian quill kills him and the skimmer plummets with Pia at the controls.
timeline.quote: a javelin punches through the window and impales him through the chest to his seat

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Huatli tells Saheeli the story of the warrior-poet Yolotzin and tells her it will be alright.
timeline.quote: What we face is no different than what she faced

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Saheeli explains that Phyrexia's oil likely carried Norn's signal and without her the compleated are inert and asleep.
timeline.quote: I think all of it was tied back to Norn.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint meets Saheeli and Huatli in a chamber of tablets and a huge golden door.
timeline.quote: This is my partner, Huatli.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Inti arrives and is introduced as Huatli's cousin and a hero of the war against the Phyrexians.
